name: Fisheye 3D Human Pose & Action Benchmark
description: A combined survey and benchmark that evaluates 3D human pose estimation and action recognition methods using fisheye camera data.
evaluation_method: MPJPE (mean per-joint position error) for pose; accuracy (or mAP) for action recognition
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark and survey that is gaining attention among researchers focused on fisheye/omnidirectional human pose and action analysis.
notes: Domain-specific (fisheye) dataset — not directly comparable to standard perspective benchmarks; metrics include both error-based (MPJPE) and classification accuracy; relatively specialized dataset size and possible domain bias.
